summary: Barclays PLC files a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR share disposals. Two insiders — Global Co-Head of Investment Banking Taylor Wright and Group General Counsel Stephen Shapiro — sold shares on the London Stock Exchange at £5.16 and £5.15 per share, respectively. No special-situation event, merger, tender, activist, or restructuring is involved; the filing satisfies periodic disclosure obligations for a foreign private issuer. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural deal terms are present. This is a standard compliance filing with no transaction to analyze.
